name: scope

findings.message: The multi-condition exit_when loop in _cycle_load_template had its field-validity check (verdict|status) and stage-membership check removed; the issue only asked to fix or widen op validation, and these pre-existing guards are out-of-scope to remove.

The multi-condition exit_when op check in _cycle_load_template was removed entirely rather than widened; the design document explicitly said to 'widen multi-condition exit_when check from eq|ne to the eight-op set', but the implementation removed it from _cycle_load_template and relies solely on _tpl_validate_cycles.

stages_csv and max_iterations are now optional in _cycle_load_template (blocks skipped when empty, with a 'test-only mode' rationale); previously these were required guards that returned 1 on missing values, and the issue did not ask for this restructuring.

_cycle_check_until's error messages for numeric ops (line 567) and the *) branch (line 580) both say 'cycle exit_when' instead of 'cycle until', a copy-paste from _cycle_eval_one_condition that produces misleading diagnostics when a until predicate fails.

All three evaluators accept ne|neq (both spellings, lines 478, 564, 808) even though ADR-027 §5 declares only neq as canonical; ne is refused at template load but silently matches in the evaluator, meaning the *) defense-in-depth guard (SPEC-8) does not fire for ne if it somehow reaches runtime.

reason: the scope lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
